description: Gares - Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.normandie.fr. Punctual geographical layer of stations in Normandy. The data does not fall within the scope of the Inspire Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Train stations - Normandy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include transports routiers, données ouvertes, réseau ferré, transports, données régionales de référence, gares. The listing shows 2021-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
